name: Kingdom of Shattered Stone
source:
Fifteen years ago, a human saved a Faerie. To repay that debt, he offered them an oath. Now, the King of Faerie must do everything in his power to hide that oath – or risk the fate of the balance between their worlds.

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
